chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Mayyāḥ, al-Madā’īnī. Narrated from his father.

key_terms.ضَعِيفٌ: Da‘īf: Weak: A narrator whose reliability is considered low due to issues like memory or accuracy.
key_terms.غَالٍ: Ghālī: A narrator or group who exaggerates the virtues or divinity of the Imams.

ai.seo_question: Who is Al-Husayn ibn Mayyāḥ al-Madā’īnī and what is his status as a narrator?
ai.summary: This entry identifies the narrator Al-usayn ibn Mayyāḥ, known as al-Madā’īnī, noting that he narrated from his father. He is characterized as a ghālī (one who exaggerates in the virtues of the Imams) and weak (da‘īf) in terms of reliability.
